content.text: {"name":"V02_x_V06_interaction_tsz","hypothesis":"Groups where the flow rate V02 is unusually high relative to its own history and the stock rate V06 is also elevated will have lower next-month returns than other groups, reflecting stress that compounds across the two variables.","falsified_if":"The cross-sectional rank correlation between this feature and next-month group returns is non-negative or statistically indistinguishable from zero in development statistics.","expression":"mult(tsz(V02,60),tsz(V06,60))"}
